Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Jokes#Vader choking people|Vader choking people]] ([[Moff Jerjerrod]]): Moff Jerjerrod clutches his throat as Darth Vader chokes him, between two of the Emperor's Royal Guards, for barring Vader's way to the Emperor's throne room. The scene is not in the finished ''Return of the Jedi''.

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:ROTJ-JerjerrodChokedByVader.png ROTJ-JerjerrodChokedByVader.png], Wookieepedia (a photograph of a scene cut from ''Return of the Jedi'' (1983); 2048 by 1378 pixels). Reduced to 800 by 538 pixels and converted to JPEG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260718185317/https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/starwars/images/b/b7/ROTJ-JerjerrodChokedByVader.png/revision/latest?cb=20250424132711 Internet Archive], 18 July 2026 (the image file). SHA-256 of the uploaded file: a3bda09883620380d7f18af72a213a117beb379356f8ec1a254ec0abc8276aeb. The scene is described in the Wookieepedia article [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tiaan_Jerjerrod Tiaan Jerjerrod] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260718185317/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tiaan_Jerjerrod Internet Archive], 18 July 2026), and Wookieepedia lists photographs of Vader choking Jerjerrod among the deleted scenes from the film ([https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Vaderchoke.jpg File:Vaderchoke.jpg]; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190325212802/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Vaderchoke.jpg Internet Archive], 25 March 2019).
